classification.difficultyReason: Construct equally spaced number lines and locate signed integers; part c also requires excluding both stated bounds before plotting the intervening integers.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a number line and mark the numbers $-12$, $-2$, $2$ and $-8$ on it.

answer.worked: Use equally spaced unit intervals. From left to right, mark $-12,-8,-2,2$.

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 4A, question 2a; teacher PDF page 7, Exercise 4A 2a
spec.description: Equally spaced unit ticks with four closed points; ordinary marks and labels use black.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Draw a number line and mark the numbers $-8$, $-3$, $-5$ and $4$ on it.

answer.worked: Use equally spaced unit intervals. From left to right, mark $-8,-5,-3,4$.

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 4A, question 2b; teacher PDF page 7, Exercise 4A 2b
spec.description: Equally spaced unit ticks with four closed points; ordinary marks and labels use black.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Draw a number line and mark the integers less than $5$ and greater than $-6$ on it.

answer.worked: Exclude $-6$ and $5$. On equally spaced unit ticks, mark every integer from $-5$ to $4$, including zero.

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 4A, question 2c; teacher PDF page 7, Exercise 4A 2c
spec.description: Equally spaced unit ticks with closed points at all ten required integers; ordinary marks and labels use black.
spec.mathematics: Every integer x satisfying -6 < x < 5 is marked.
